hooks.name: kgai-session-start
hooks.description: Install the kg engine if needed, sync with the team remote in the background, and hand the model this repo's capture rules.

hooks.name: kgai-turn-state
hooks.description: Note that this turn edited code, or already recorded a decision.

hooks.name: kgai-auto-capture
hooks.description: If the turn edited code and recorded nothing, require the capture decision before the turn ends.

hooks.name: kgai-sync
hooks.description: Push this session's decisions to the team remote.
